caption: A door slams in a hallway, and a set of keys hanging on a hook beside it swings and jingles.

sa.check: A hallway door with a set of keys hanging on a hook beside it.
The keys swing and shake on the hook.
The keys stay on the hook.
The slam comes first and the swing follows.

pc.expect: The keys hang still until the door slams and start moving at the slam.
pc.fail: The keys swing before the door reaches its frame; or the door slams and the keys hang dead still; or the keys start swinging again after settling with the door already closed.

pc.expect: After the slam the swing shrinks until the keys hang still.
pc.fail: The arcs grow after the slam; or the keys stop dead in a tilted pose; or they swing at the same width until the end with no second slam.

pc.expect: The keys hang below the hook and at rest hang straight down.
pc.fail: The keys rest tilted with nothing touching them; or rise above the hook; or float off the hook without falling.

pc.expect: The door turns on its hinges into its frame and stops there.
pc.fail: The door slides sideways rather than turning on its hinges; or halts short of the frame and is then shown shut with no movement between; or swings shut and open again with nothing touching it.

pc.expect: One set of keys, one hook, one door; nothing passes through the wall or frame.
pc.fail: A second set of keys appears; or the keys vanish; or the door passes through its frame or wall; or the hook moves through the wall.

pc.expect: The keys' fobs, the door's colour and the wall stay the same.
pc.fail: The keys change number or colour; or the door changes colour; or the wall changes.
